facts.text: I do not know what wasabi is, but I ain't eating it again. Pass me the real pistachio ice cream, friend.
facts.why: Mater never says this. The quote page lists his real lines. It is printed in quote marks as his words.

vibe.verdict: The wasabi gag lands in the takoyaki and pistachio notes and Mater signs off, but the pit lane stadium is still a generic venue.
